name: SetIpuMpeg1Mode
evidence: sets or clears bit 23 of the IPU's control register 0x10002010, the MPEG-1 mode, as the sequence header says

name: WaitIpuDecodeDone
evidence: waits for the IPU's block decode, running the decoder's callback of kind 1 while its input runs dry, refreshes the bit window and reports "Error code detected(BDEC)" and resets the IPU on an error

name: DecodeIpuMotionCode
evidence: decodes one value with the IPU's variable-length table 3 (the motion vector's dmvector code, which ReadMotionVector reads after each component)

name: ComputeDualPrimeVectors
evidence: for a frame picture (mode 3) or a field, turns a vector and a signed difference into two or four derived vectors by half and three halves of the difference, rounded toward zero, plus the vector

name: ReadMacroblockAddressIncrement
evidence: reads the macroblock address increment with the IPU's table 0, adding 33 for each escape code and skipping the stuffing code, and reports an invalid code

name: DecodeAllMacroblocks
evidence: decodes every macroblock of a picture (half of them for a field) with DecodeSliceMacroblocks, then adds the residuals, reporting "= Skip to the next picture =" on an error

name: ReadSliceStart
evidence: finds the next start code, checks it is a slice code (0x101 to 0x1AF), reads the slice's quantiser and address increment and gives the first macroblock's index

name: DecodeSliceMacroblocks
evidence: decodes macroblocks up to a count, reading each slice's start and each macroblock's address increment, and returns 1 to 3 when it has to stop

name: HandleSkippedMacroblock
evidence: sets up a skipped macroblock's motion fields by the picture structure and reports "skiped macroblock in I picure is not allowed" for an intra picture

name: DecodeMacroblock
evidence: reads a macroblock's type, motion type, quantiser and motion vectors by the picture's coding and sends the IPU the command that decodes its blocks (DecodeSliceMacroblocks calls it)

name: ApplyMotionVectorDelta
evidence: adds a decoded motion code and residual to a motion vector component, wrapping it into the range of the vector size and halving it first and doubling it after for half-resolution

name: ReadFieldMotionVector
evidence: reads a motion vector of a macroblock in the MPEG-2 layout: a field select bit before each of the vector's two halves for field motion, copying the vector for the other half for frame motion

name: ReadMotionVector
evidence: reads a motion vector's two components with the IPU's table 2 (with the residual bits when the size is non-zero), applies each with ApplyMotionVectorDelta and optionally a dmvector code

name: SendIpuCommand
evidence: writes a command to the IPU's command register 0x10002000 and records what its kind leaves in the bit window (D_0027B040)

name: WaitIpuCommandDone
evidence: waits while the IPU is busy, running the stall callback every 5000 polls

name: WaitIpuCommandResult
evidence: waits while the IPU's command register 0x10002000 reads negative and no error is set, running the stall callback every 5001 polls, and returns the register

name: DecodeIpuVariableLength
evidence: waits for the IPU, then sends it a variable-length decode command of a table and reads the decoded value

name: PeekIpuBits
evidence: returns the next n bits of the IPU's bit stream without consuming them

name: SkipIpuBits
evidence: sends the IPU a command that consumes n bits and refreshes the bit window

name: ReadIpuBits
evidence: returns the next n bits of the IPU's bit stream and consumes them

name: FindNextStartCode
evidence: aligns the IPU's bit stream to a byte and skips to the next start code prefix 0x000001

name: ReadSliceQuantiser
evidence: reads a slice's 5-bit quantiser scale and skips the extra slice information bytes

name: ParseMpegHeaders
evidence: reads start codes and their headers: a sequence header (0x1B3), a group of pictures (0x1B8), a picture (0x100), until the sequence's end (0x1B7)

name: ReadPictureHeader
evidence: reads a picture header: its temporal reference, coding type, delay and the forward and backward codes of P and B pictures

name: ReadExtensionsAndUserData
evidence: reads the extensions and user data after a header, dispatching each extension through the table D_00250430

name: ReadPictureCodingExtension
evidence: reads the picture coding extension's four 4-bit vector sizes, the intra DC precision, the picture structure and the flags of the picture's coding, setting the IPU's control register bits

name: SkipExtraInformation
evidence: skips bytes of extra information while the bit before each is set

name: UpdatePictureOrder
evidence: adds the picture header's temporal reference to the group of pictures' base to get the picture's order number, raised to the highest seen

name: ReadGroupOfPicturesHeader
evidence: reads a group of pictures header: its time code, closed and broken flags

name: ReadQuantiserMatrixExtension
evidence: reads the quantiser matrix extension's four load flags, loading the intra and non-intra matrices with the IPU's commands and reporting the chroma matrices as unsupported

name: ReadPictureDisplayExtension
evidence: reads the picture display extension's offsets, one to three pairs of a 16-bit horizontal and vertical offset by the picture structure and flags

name: ReadCopyrightExtension
evidence: reads and discards the copyright extension: its flags, identifier and the three numbers of 20 and 22 bits

name: DecodePictureData
evidence: picks the output picture by the picture structure (reporting "odd number of field pictures" or "unknown picture sutructure") and decodes its macroblocks with DecodeAllMacroblocks

name: OutputPictureIfDecoded
evidence: when its flag is set, outputs the current picture by its structure with OutputFramePicture or OutputFieldPicturePair, then moves a pending state of 1 on to 2

name: SelectPictureBuffer
evidence: chooses and rotates the picture buffers for the current picture, fills the chosen buffer's record from the header's fields and returns whether the references it needs are decoded

name: CheckPictureBufferSize
evidence: checks the output buffer is big enough for the picture, reporting "Too small buffer size for %dx%d picture" otherwise

name: CopyPictureThroughScratchpad
evidence: copies a picture to the output buffer row by row, each through DMA channel 8 into the scratchpad and channel 9 back out, one or two passes by the picture's structure

name: SignalPictureReady
evidence: sets the state's mode word to 2, copies the current picture number to the output number and sets the flag at +0x820 that ends the picture loop

name: FillPictureOutputInfo
evidence: works out an output picture's timestamp and flags from its record and the decoder's running timestamps

name: OutputFramePicture
evidence: outputs a frame picture: fills its timestamp and flags, checks the buffer size and, when the picture is decoded, copies or converts it to the output and signals it

name: OutputFieldPicturePair
evidence: outputs a pair of field pictures in the order the picture structure gives, fills the timestamps and flags, and converts or copies the interleaved fields to the output

name: StartBlockChainToScratchpad
evidence: builds a DMA chain of two source tags per block of the current picture in uncached memory and starts channel 9 on it with interrupts disabled

name: StartIpuOutputDma
evidence: with interrupts disabled, starts the IPU's output DMA channel 3 towards an address for a number of bytes

name: ConvertSmallPictureColours
evidence: converts a small picture's colours: starts the IPU's output DMA, sends the convert command and runs the callback of kind 4, then waits for both to end

name: ContinueColourConversionOutput
evidence: the DMA handler of the colour conversion's output channel: counts a chunk done, starts the next chunk of 0x3FF quadwords or the rest, and flags an error when the channel is still busy

name: ConvertLargePictureColours
evidence: converts a large picture's colours in chunks: installs ContinueColourConversionOutput on channel 3, starts the first chunk, runs the callback of kind 4 and waits for the chunks, reporting "CSC handler error" on failure

name: ContinueColourConversionInput
evidence: the DMA handler of the colour conversion's input channel: starts the next chunk of up to 0xFFFF quadwords to the IPU and ends with 1 when none is left

name: ConvertPictureColours
evidence: converts a decoded picture's colours with the IPU by DMA, through interrupt handlers for large pictures
